The tokenizer in src/tokenizer.ts is the part of exprlex that the rule editor and the rule
linter also implement, and it only has three tests (test/tokenizer.test.ts) even though
other code depends on every detail of its output. The agreed token rules are in
docs/TOKEN_RULES.md; the language tooling team owns that file, so please do not edit it.

Please write tests for the tokenizer in test/tokenizer.test.ts (or in new files under
test/) so that a regression in it would be caught. The tests should pin what the rules
document says about:

- numbers;
- operators, punctuation, and keywords;
- strings and their escapes;
- separators, comments, and positions, including the end token and error messages.

The existing tests and the new ones should pass when you are done. Please leave src/ as it
is: this is about tests, not about changing the tokenizer.
